text: Allow me to explain the Gym mission for\nStow-on-Side’s Gym!
To complete the mission, you’ll need to ride in\none of these cups and make your way to the goal\r\nwhile trying to avoid obstacles!

Let me tell you a bit more about how to operate
this fun attraction.\c
Rotate your control stick to the right and the cup
will start to spin to the right.
Rotate it to the left to make the cup spin left!

If you hit a wall, rotate the stick as quick as you
can to get yourself out of that sticky situation!\c
Now, have a good time watching the world spin
as you try to reach the goal!
Then on you spin! And good luck!
Use the control stick to spin your cup, and\nmake your way to the goal!
If you withdraw, you’ll have to start over the next\ntime you give the mission a try. So, are you sure?
Then I look forward to your next attempt!

Smashing job clearing that Gym mission,
Challenger [VAR 0100(0000)]!\c
Would you like to carry on to challenge the
Gym Leader at once?
Very good! Then on you go!\nThe Gym Leader is one obstacle you can’t avoid!
Naturally, you must want to jot down a report of\nyour progress and ready yourself. I understand!
